l-m-e2-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: Sanduuqa la bixiyay wuxuu ka kooban yahay 12 qalin, sidaas darteed waa inaad 36 ka jartaa 12.

l-m-e2-b01-30.material: Shaxdani waxay muujisaa sahan ku saabsan midhaha la jecel yahay. 7 arday ayaa jecel tufaax 4 arday-na jecel yihiin pears. U beddel lambarrada shaxda weedh is barbar dhigaysa.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.prompt: Dooro weedhda macnaheedu la mid yahay shaxda.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.o.a: 3 arday oo dheeraad ah ayaa jecel pears marka loo eego tufaax
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad akhriday tufaax iyo pears si khaldan.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.o.b: 3 arday oo dheeraad ah ayaa jecel tufaax marka loo eego pears
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.o.c: 11 arday oo dheeraad ah ayaa jecel tufaax marka loo eego pears
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad u isticmaashay wadarta 7 iyo 4 sida farqiga. Farqiga waxaad ku hesha dhimis.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.o.d: Isla tirada ardayda ayaa jecel tufaax iyo pears
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay in 7 iyo 4 ay le'eg yihiin.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s1.explain: Farqiga u dhexeeya 7 arday iyo 4 arday waa 7−4=3 arday. Tufaax ayaa badan, sidaas darteed tufaax wuxuu leeyahay 3 oo dheeraad ah.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s2.model.0: 7 waa ka weyn 4, sidaas darteed tufaax ayaa badan, 7−4=3-na, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 3 oo dheeraad ah.
l-m-e2-b01-30.s.s2.model.1: Ka qaadista 4 arday oo pears ah 7 arday oo tufaax ah waxay ka tagtaa 3, sidaas darteed tufaax wuxuu leeyahay 3 oo dheeraad ah.

l-m-e2-b05-26.goal: U muuji imisa doonat ayaa wadar ahaan jira si kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-e2-b05-26.material: Waxaa jira 3 sanduuq oo mid walba ku jira 4 doonat, iyo 2 doonat oo kale oo goonida ah. Waxaad rabtaa inaad u qorto imisa doonat ayaa wadar ahaan jira hal isla'eg.
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s1.prompt: Isla'eg kee ayaa isla macnaha la leh sheekada?
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s1.r.a: Tirada sanduuqyada iyo tirada ayaa si fudud loo isku daray. 3 sanduuq oo 4 ah waa 4×3.
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s1.r.c: 2 doonat ee goonida ah waxaa loo qaatay 2 sanduuq.
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s1.r.d: 2 doonat ee goonida ah waa lagu daraa, lagama dhufto.
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s1.explain: 3 sanduuq oo 4 ah waa 4×3=12, marka lagu daro 2 ka goonida ah waxay noqonaysaa 12+2=14.
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: 3 sanduuq oo 4 ah waa 4×3, ka dibna 2 ka goonida ah ayaa lagu daraa, sidaas darteed u qor sida 4×3+2=14.
l-m-e2-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: Doonatka sanduuqyada ku jira waxaa lagu tiriyaa isku dhufasho kan goonida ahna isku darid, sidaas darteed 4×3+2 waxay isla macno la leedahay sheekada.

l-m-e2-b05-28.goal: U muuji 2 maalmood si kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-e2-b05-28.material: Hal maalin waa 24 saacadood. Waxaad rabtaa inaad 2 maalmood u beddesho 'saacadood' oo keliya si ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s1.prompt: 2 maalmood imisa saacadood ayay le'eg yihiin?
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s1.r.a: Taasi waa saacadaha 1 maalin. Maadaama ay tahay 2 maalmood, mid kale ayaa jira.
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s1.r.b: 2 iyo 24 ayaa la isku daray. 24 saacadood waxay dhacaan 2 jeer.
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s1.r.d: 2 iyo 24 ayaa la isku xiray la qoray.
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s1.explain: Hal maalin waa 24 saacadood. 2 maalmood waa 24+24=48 saacadood.
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s2.model.0: Hal maalin waa 24 saacadood, sidaas darteed 2 maalmood waxaa loo beddeli karaa 24+24=48 saacadood.
l-m-e2-b05-28.s.s2.model.1: 2 maalmood waa 2 jeer 24 saacadood, taas oo ah 24×2=48 saacadood, sidaas darteed waa isla waqtiga.

l-m-e2-b05-29.title: Sheeko kee ayaa ku haboon 6×4=24?
l-m-e2-b05-29.goal: U muuji 6×4=24 si kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-e2-b05-29.material: Waxaa jirta isla'eg isku dhufasho ah 6×4=24. Waxaad rabtaa inaad dooratid sheekada isla macnaha la leh isla'egtan.
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.prompt: Sheeko kee ayaa isla macnaha la leh 6×4=24?
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.o.a: 6 qof saf kasta iyo 4 saf waxay wadar ahaan noqonayaan 24 qof
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.o.b: 6 qof ayaa taagan 4 kalena way yimaadaan, taasoo noqonaysa 10
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.r.b: Waa sheeko ku saabsan isku darid, sidaas darteed waa 6+4=10.
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.o.c: 6 ka mid ah 24 qof ayaa baxa, sidaas darteed 18 qof ayaa hadha
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.r.c: Waa sheeko ku saabsan ka-jarid, sidaas darteed waa 24−6=18.
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.r.d: Waa sheeko ku saabsan isbarbardhig, sidaas darteed waa 6−4=2.
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s1.explain: Haddii ay jiraan 4 saf oo mid walba 6 qof ah, waa 6×4=24 qof. Sheeko isla lambarka lagu soo ururiyo marar badan waa isku dhufasho.
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s2.model.0: Waa sheeko ay isla lambarka, 6 qof, lagu soo ururiyo 4 jeer, sidaas darteed waxay isla macno la leedahay 6×4=24.
l-m-e2-b05-29.s.s2.model.1: Sheekooyinka kale waa ku saabsan isku darid ama ka-jarid, sidaas darteed macnahoodu wuu ka duwan yahay isku dhufashada 6×4=24.
